heads.asset:
In this email, we should:
- present the event to the heads of departments and PIs
- ask them to either nominate people or, if they know anyone, we should invite
- distribute or forward the message to any newsletters or channels they might have
- suggest experts or researchers from their lab or adjacent labs that we should invite
Keep the email short. It should fit into one phone scroll.

social.asset: This post should read as the {{university}}, {{faculty}}, or department actually inviting their members or students, as partners of the meetup, to the meetup, so right from the POV of the institution towards the audience. Remember that the university messaging and the organizers are distinct, so the poster should not refer to themselves as the organizer.

press.asset:
# Press release guidelines

1. Issue the release before the initiative starts.
2. Write the news in the first two sentences. They must stand on their own.
3. Say why the news matters.
4. Use the next one or two paragraphs for the news. Then say who is behind the initiative.
5. Include:
   - why it is happening and the issue behind it
   - who is running it and their qualifications
   - the expected timeline
   - a quote from a senior person in the lead organisation
6. Include only facts.
7. End with contact details: name, phone, email, website.

list.v: V4AIR: find your next collaborator, 28–30 April 2027
V4AIR: a meetup for early-career researchers who use AI
Fully funded for early-career researchers at {{university_short}} who use AI. Apply by 15 January 2027.
Three days at Kostelec Castle near Prague, 28–30 April 2027. Fully funded for {{university_short}} participants.
Three days at a castle near Prague, 28–30 April 2027. Fully funded for {{university_short}} participants.

Dear colleagues,

If AI is part of your research, V4AIR is for you, whatever your field.

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings early-career researchers and students from the four Visegrad countries to Kostelec Castle near Prague on 28–30 April 2027. For three days, you live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.

**Find your next collaborator**

Maybe you need a co-author from outside your field, or a student who can code. When you apply, tell us what expertise your project is missing and who you want to meet. We invite people who match and put you in the room with them.

At V4AIR you can:

- find collaborators and team members
- get advice from experts
- talk to people from industry about paths outside academia

If your next grant needs a partner from another V4 country, you can meet them at Kostelec this April.

**Who should apply**

AI can be the tool you use every day or the thing you study. A biologist training models on field data and a historian mining digitized archives both belong at V4AIR. You can apply as a PhD student, a postdoc, or a researcher still early in building a group. If you're not sure whether you count as early-career, apply.

**Your answers build the programme**

The application form asks what you work on, what you want to learn and who you want to meet. From the answers, we choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

**You do not need a paper to apply**

V4AIR has no proceedings. Bring the work you are doing now. Works in progress and projects that got stuck are welcome. Everyone contributes in some form, and if you're selected, we shape your contribution with you.

**Free and fully funded**

If you work at {{university}} or another partner university, you pay no participation fee. The International Visegrad Fund covers:

- accommodation at the castle
- meals for the three days
- a contribution toward your travel, scaled by distance

The partner universities are Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław, and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń. If you're from another institution and not a student, write to us at kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz.

**How selection works**

There's no CV and no motivation letter. We select for fit and mix, so the order in which applications arrive doesn't matter. The core of your application is reviewed without your institution's name.

**Practical details**

- **When:** Wednesday 28 April 2027 from midday to Friday 30 April in the evening. We expect you for all three days.
- **Where:** Kostelec Castle in Kostelec nad Černými lesy, about 30 minutes from Prague.
- **Language:** English.
- **Results:** February 2027.

**Apply by 15 January 2027:** https://v4air.eu/apply/

Know someone in your group who should come? Nominate them in two minutes: https://v4air.eu/nominate/

Questions, ideas or collaboration offers: kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz

Invitation: a funded AI meetup for students, 28–30 April
Three days at Kostelec Castle near Prague for students who use AI. Apply by 15 January 2027.

Dear students,

We would like to introduce V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup. It brings students and early-career researchers from the four Visegrad countries to Kostelec Castle, about 30 minutes from Prague, on 28–30 April 2027.

**If AI is part of your studies or research, you belong here, whatever your field.** {{examples}} both belong at V4AIR. You don't have to build AI to take part.

Over three days at the castle, you can:

- find a mentor or a research position
- meet the people you choose: you tell us who in your application
- present your project in the Not-Just-Posters session and get feedback, even before you have results

You do not need a paper or an abstract. Works in progress are welcome. The talks and speakers are chosen from what applicants say they want to learn.

**Free for {{university_short}} students.** No participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals, and a contribution toward travel are covered by the International Visegrad Fund.

Apply by 15 January 2027. Results come in February 2027. The meetup is in English.

If you use AI in your research, V4AIR is for you, whatever your field. You can apply as a master's or PHdstudent.

**Meet the people you want to learn from.**
When you apply, you tell us who you want to meet, and we put you in the room with them. You can find mentors and research positions, and get feedback on your ideas.

**You do not need results.**
Present your project in the Not-Just-Posters session and get feedback while it is still in progress. The application form also asks what you want to learn, and we choose the talks and speakers from your answers.

**Free and fully funded.**
As a student at {{university}}, you pay no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the International Visegrad Fund.

{{CTA}}

Applications are open until 15 January 2027. The event is held in English.

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings together students and early-career researchers who apply AI, from six universities in the four Visegrad countries. {{university}} is one of them.

If you want your researchers working with colleagues across the V4, V4AIR puts them in one place for three days. From 28 to 30 April 2027, they live and work together at Kostelec Castle in Kostelec nad Černými lesy, about 30 minutes from Prague.

**Who can apply**

Bachelor's and master's students, PhD students, postdocs and researchers still early in building a group can apply, in any field where they use AI. The event is in English.

**Funding**

For the six partner universities there is no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project. The partner universities are Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

**Programme and dates**

The programme is shaped by the people who apply. The application form asks what they work on, what they want to learn and who they want to meet, and the talks, workshop topics and invited speakers are chosen from their answers.

The deadline is 15 January 2027. Results follow in February 2027.

V4AIR connects AI talent across the Visegrad region. The meetup puts young researchers from Prague, Budapest, Bratislava, Wrocław and Toruń who apply AI in one place for three days. Participants live and work together at the castle and meet counterparts from three other countries.

**Who can take part**

The meetup is open to people who use AI in their research, in any field. Bachelor's and master's students, PhD students, postdocs and researchers still early in building a group can apply. No finished paper is required. Participants bring the work they are doing now.

**A programme shaped by participants**

The application form asks applicants what they work on, what they want to learn and who they want to meet. The organisers use these answers to choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

**Funding**

V4AIR is supported by the International Visegrad Fund. For students and researchers at the six partner universities there is no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project. Students from other institutions can take part for 160 euro.

The partner universities are Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

{{CTA}}

**Selection**

There is no CV and no motivation letter. Applicants are selected for fit and mix, so the order in which applications arrive does not matter. The core of each application is reviewed without the name of the applicant's institution.

**Practical details**

- **When:** Wednesday 28 April 2027 from midday to Friday 30 April 2027 in the evening
- **Where:** Kostelec Castle, Kostelec nad Černými lesy, about 30 minutes from Prague
- **Language:** English
- **Application deadline:** 15 January 2027
- **Results:** February 2027

**Contact**

Questions, ideas or collaboration offers: kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz

Meet the people your research needs.

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings students and early-career researchers from the four Visegrad countries to Kostelec Castle, about 30 minutes from Prague, on 28–30 April 2027. For three days, you live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.

Whatever your field, if you apply AI in your research, this meetup is for you. You can apply as a bachelor's or master's student, a PhD student, a postdoc or a researcher still early in building a group.

Tell us who you want to meet. We put you in the room with them. You can find collaborators and team members, mentors and research positions, get advice from experts and talk to people from industry.

You take part in shaping the programme. The application form asks what you work on, what you want to learn and who you want to meet. From what you tell us, we choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

You don't need a finished paper. Bring the work you're doing now. Projects that got stuck are welcome too. If you don't have results yet, you can present in the Not-Just-Posters session and get feedback on your project.

At {{university}}, you pay no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project.

There's no CV and no motivation letter. The meetup is in English.

Meet the people your research needs. 28–30 April 2027
Graphic for V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup at Kostelec Castle near Prague, with the text: Meet the people your research needs. 28–30 April 2027.

Who is missing from your team? Tell us, and we invite people who match.

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings students and early-career researchers from the four Visegrad countries to Kostelec Castle near Prague on 28–30 April 2027. For three days, you live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.

If AI is part of your research, you should apply, whatever your field. You don't have to build AI to belong here. You can apply as a PhD student, a postdoc or a researcher still early in building a group. If you're not sure whether you count as early-career, apply.

At V4AIR you can:
- find collaborators and team members, including a co-author from outside your field
- get advice from experts
- talk to people from industry
- get feedback on the work you are doing now

You take part in shaping the programme. The application form asks what you work on, what you want to learn and who you want to meet. From what you tell us, we choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

You don't need an abstract or a finished paper. Works in progress and projects that got stuck are welcome. There is no CV and no motivation letter.

If you study or work at {{university}} or another partner university, there is no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project.

The partner universities are Charles University, Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

The meetup runs in English. Results come in February 2027.

Apply by 15 January 2027: https://v4air.eu/apply/

Know someone who should come? Nominate them: https://v4air.eu/nominate/

Questions: kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz

#V4AIR #AI #EarlyCareerResearchers

Who is missing from your team? Tell us, and we invite people who match.

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings students and early-career researchers from the four Visegrad countries to Kostelec Castle near Prague on 28–30 April 2027. For three days, you live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.

If AI is part of your research, you should apply, whatever your field.  You can apply as a PhD student, a postdoc or a researcher still early in building a group. If you're not sure whether you count as early-career, apply.

At V4AIR you can:
- find collaborators and team members, including a co-author from outside your field
- get advice from experts
- talk to people from industry
- get feedback on the work you are doing now

You take part in shaping the programme. The application form asks what you work on, what you want to learn and who you want to meet. From what you tell us, we choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

You don't need an abstract or a finished paper. Works in progress and projects that got stuck are welcome. There is no CV and no motivation letter.

If you study or work at {{university}} or another partner university, there is no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project.

The partner universities are Charles University, Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

The meetup runs in English. Results come in February 2027.

Apply by 15 January 2027: https://v4air.eu/apply/

Know someone who should come? Nominate them: https://v4air.eu/nominate/

Questions: kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz

Young researchers from Prague, Budapest, Bratislava, Wrocław and Toruń who apply AI will spend three days in one castle this April. V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, connects AI talent across the Visegrad region. For three days, participants live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.

**Six partner universities**

The partner universities are Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń. Researchers at {{university}} will meet their counterparts from the other three countries at Kostelec.

**Who can take part**

The meetup is open to bachelor's and master's students, PhD students, postdocs and researchers still early in building a group, in any field where they use AI in their research.

**A programme shaped by the participants**

The application form asks applicants what they work on, what they want to learn and who they want to meet. From their answers, the organisers choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

**Funding**

Participants from the partner universities pay no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project, which is supported by the International Visegrad Fund, Grant No. 22610317. Students from other institutions can take part for 160 euro.

- **When:** 28–30 April 2027

- **Language:** English
- **Application deadline:** 15 January 2027
- **Results:** February 2027

If you use AI in your research, V4AIR is for you, whatever your field.

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings students and early-career researchers from the four Visegrad countries to Kostelec Castle near Prague on 28–30 April 2027. For three days, you live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.

## Who it's for

V4AIR is for people who apply AI methods in their research. You don't need to build or study AI itself. You can apply as a bachelor's or master's student, a PhD student, a postdoc, or a researcher still early in building a group. If you're not sure whether you count as early-career, apply.

## Meet the people your research needs

When you apply, you tell us who you want to meet. We use your answers to put you in the room with them.

- If you're an early-career researcher, you can find collaborators and team members, get advice from experts and talk to people from industry.
- If you're a student, you can find mentors and research positions, and get feedback on your ideas.

## You shape the programme

The application form asks what you work on, what you want to learn and who you want to meet. From what you tell us, we choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

## You don't need a finished paper

Bring the work you're doing now. Projects that got stuck are welcome too. Everyone contributes in some form, and if you're selected, we shape your contribution with you. If you don't have results yet, you can present your project in the Not-Just-Posters session and get feedback on it.

## Fully funded for the six partner universities

If you study or work at {{university}} or another partner university, you pay no participation fee. The following are covered by the project:

- accommodation at the castle
- meals for the three days
- a contribution toward your travel, scaled by distance

The partner universities are Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

If you're a student at another institution, you can take part for 160 euro. If you're at another institution and not a student, write to us at kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz.

{{CTA}}

## How selection works

There's no CV and no motivation letter. We select for fit and mix, so the order in which applications arrive doesn't matter. The core of your application is reviewed without your institution's name. A careful application is the best thing you can do for your chances.

## Practical details

- **When:** Wednesday 28 April 2027 from midday to Friday 30 April in the evening. We expect you for all three days.
- **Where:** Kostelec Castle in Kostelec nad Černými lesy, about 30 minutes from Prague.
- **Language:** English.
- **Deadline:** 15 January 2027.
- **Results:** February 2027.

It is a three-day meetup for students and early-career researchers from the four Visegrad countries. For three days, you live and work in one place with people who apply AI across disciplines.



## Who it's for

V4AIR is for people who apply AI methods in their research. You don't need to build or study AI itself to take part. You can apply as a bachelor's or master's student, a PhD student, a postdoc, or a researcher still early in building a group. If you're not sure whether you qualify as early-career, you are invited to apply.

## Meet the people your research needs

When you apply, you will have the opportunity to say who you want to meet. The organisers use your answers to target specific people to meet your demand and put you in the room with them.

- If you're an early-career researcher, you can find collaborators and team members, get advice from experts and talk to people from industry.
- If you're a student, you can find mentors and research positions, get feedback on your ideas and apply what you know in new contexts.

## You shape the programme

You take part in shaping the programme. The application form asks what you work on, what you want to learn and who you want to meet. From your answers, the organisers choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

## You don't need a finished paper

V4AIR is an interdisciplinary meetup with no proceedings, and you don't need a  an abstract or a finished paper to apply. Your current work-in-progress or stuck projects are welcome. The organisers will get in touch to shape your contribution with you. If you're a student and you're not ready for a talk yet, you can present your project in the Not-Just-Posters session and get feedback on it.

## Fully funded for the six partner universities

Because {{university_short}} is a partner, students pay no participation fee.
The following are covered by the project:

- accommodation at the castle
- meals for the three days
- a contribution toward your travel, scaled by distance

The partner universities are Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

If you're a student at another institution, you can take part for 160 euro. If you're at another institution and not a student, write to the organisers at kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz.

{{CTA}}

## How selection works

There's no CV and no motivation letter. Selection is based on fit and mix, so the order in which applications arrive doesn't matter. The core of your application is reviewed without your institution's name. A careful application is the best thing you can do for your chances.

## Practical details

- **When:** Wednesday 28 April 2027 from midday to Friday 30 April in the evening. You are expected for all three days.
- **Where:** Kostelec Castle in Kostelec nad Černými lesy, about 30 minutes from Prague.
- **Language:** English.
- **Deadline:** 15 January 2027.
- **Results:** February 2027.

heads.cover_note: I am writing about V4AIR, a three-day meetup at Kostelec Castle near Prague on 28–30 April 2027 for students and early-career researchers who use AI in their research. Participation is covered by the project for {{university}}. I would be grateful if you could pass the call on and tell us who we should invite.
heads.body:
Dear colleague,

V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, brings together students and early-career researchers who apply AI, from six universities in the four Visegrad countries. We meet at Kostelec Castle, about 30 minutes from Prague, on 28–30 April 2027.

The meetup is methods-first. It is for anyone who uses AI in their research, whatever the field. Its core is matchmaking: participants tell us who they want to meet, and we put them in the room with collaborators, team members and experts. It is not a formal conference and has no proceedings, so works in progress are welcome. The programme is built from what participants say they want to learn.

For {{university}} there is no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project. Applications close on 15 January 2027.

{{CTA}}

**How you can help**

- Forward this call to your PhD students, postdocs and junior faculty, and to any newsletters or mailing lists your department runs.
- Tell us about people you think should come.
- Suggest experts or researchers from your lab or adjacent labs whom we should invite. A reply to this email is enough.

Thank you for your help.

press.body:
From 28 to 30 April 2027, V4AIR, the V4 AI Researchers Meetup, will bring together students and early-career researchers who use AI in their research, from six universities in the four Visegrad countries. The meetup takes place at Kostelec Castle in Kostelec nad Černými lesy, about 30 minutes from Prague. Applications are open until 15 January 2027.

**Why it matters**

Universities in the region want their researchers working with colleagues across the V4. V4AIR puts them in one place for three days. Participants live and work together with people who apply AI across disciplines and meet their counterparts from three other countries.

**Open to all fields**

The meetup is for anyone who uses AI in their research, whatever their field. Bachelor's and master's students, PhD students, postdocs and researchers early in building a group can apply. Applicants help shape the programme. The application form asks what they work on, what they want to learn and who they want to meet. From their answers, the organisers choose the talks, the workshop topics and the invited speakers.

Selection does not require a CV or a motivation letter. Applicants are selected for fit and mix, so the order in which applications arrive does not matter. The core of each application is reviewed without the name of the applicant's institution.

**Funding**

Students and researchers at the six partner universities pay no participation fee. Accommodation at the castle, meals and a contribution toward travel are covered by the project, which is supported by the International Visegrad Fund. Students from other institutions can take part for 160 euro. The event is held in English.

{{CTA}}

**Timeline**

- Applications close: 15 January 2027
- Results: February 2027
- Meetup: 28–30 April 2027, Kostelec Castle

**Who is behind V4AIR**

V4AIR is a joint initiative of six partner universities: Charles University, the Czech Technical University in Prague, Comenius University Bratislava, Eötvös Loránd University, the University of Wrocław and Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń.

**Contact**

- Name: {{contact_person}}
- Phone: [to be confirmed]
- Email: kutsosp@natur.cuni.cz
- Website: https://v4air.eu

*V4AIR is supported by the International Visegrad Fund, Grant No. 22610317.*
